blocking.title: Undo (and any load) leaves the undone burst's ruins and fallout drawn on the map
blocking.evidence: node critic/scripts/c68_undo.mjs 41201 30: hash 3597411667 before the H-bomb on Berlin and after Undo, yet the burned disc and ruins stay (critic/shots/c68u_41201_04_berlin_937_undone.png, c68u_41201_06_berlin_150_undone.png, c68u_41201_08_berlin_937_after_undo_48h.png vs c68u_41201_00_berlin_937_before.png). c68_undo2.mjs 41211 + c68_pixdiff.py: nuke undone after 2 s differs by 7,028 px from before, other tools 0-31 px (critic/shots/c68u2_41211_nuke_pair.png). c68_loadruins.mjs 41203: a load of a pre-burst save keeps the scar (c68lr_41203_02_loaded_937.png) while a fresh page with the same save and hash 149009271 is clean (c68lr_41203_04_fresh_937.png). Cause: src/worker/server.ts ~902/910 sends fallout and ruins only when the world has some or the last sent had some; loaded() resets the sent counts to -1, so an empty layer is never sent and the client keeps the old one (same guard at 6e0e46f3, so the load path is old; R81b makes it one click). The same load case on run 67's build (6e0e46f3, critic/wt) shows the identical 2,519 px scar (critic/shots/c68lr6e0e_41203_02_crop.png): the load path is old; R81b's Undo is the new way to it.
blocking.fix: After loaded() (load or Undo), always send the fallout and ruins layers once, empty included; add a spec that compares the picture before an act and after its Undo, not only the hash. Seen fixed when c68_undo2.mjs 41211 shows 0 px differing for the nuke and c68_loadruins.mjs 41203 shot 02 equals shot 04.
